provider: Alibaba Bailian / DashScope File API (QwenCloud SG)

free_tier.stated: 100 GB total per workspace; 10,000 files; NO expiry ('暂时没有有效期限制' — no validity-period limit for now). Per-file: 150 MB for purpose=file-extract, 500 MB for purpose=batch, 300 MB for fine-tune, 50 MB for the newer Agent Studio endpoint.

egress.terms: No metered egress on file retrieval. The legacy get-file endpoint returns a pre-signed aliyuncs.com OSS URL, i.e. served from Alibaba OSS rather than a billed gateway.

interface_detail: OpenAI-compatible: base_url https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1 with the openai SDK; also https://dashscope-intl.aliyuncs.com for international, and https://maas.qwencloudapi.com/compatible-mode/v1 for the Singapore QwenCloud brand
tooling: openai-python with a swapped base_url; curl multipart; documented endpoints upload/retrieve/list/delete plus GET /files/{file_id}/content
chaining: 100 GB per workspace, and workspaces are a creatable dimension. 'Never expire' is the whole point: this is the only major /v1/files endpoint found that gives permanent retention on the free tier. At 500 MB/batch file, 10,000 files = 5 TB of nominal slots against a 100 GB byte wall — the byte wall binds.

limits.value: review status (`checking` -> `available`/`rejected`) before they can be referenced

limits_note: per-object-cap 150 MB (file-extract) / 500 MB (batch). 100 GB workspace byte cap and 10,000-file count cap, whichever hits first. Files enter a safety-review status (`checking` -> `available`/`rejected`) before they can be referenced.
reliability_note: TWO CONTRADICTORY READ PATHS depending on which generation of the API you use. The NEW Agent Studio `GET /files/{file_id}/content` documents 'only files with downloadable=true can be downloaded; files uploaded directly or copied into a session sandbox are downloadable=false and return 400' — a read gate. The file-list example on the same doc set literally shows `"downloadable": false` on a directly uploaded CSV. But the LEGACY `GET /api/v1/files/{file_id}` returns a signed OSS `url` in the metadata, which is a real read path. The docs say the legacy interface is 'mainly for compatibility with historical scenarios', so its survival is not guaranteed — probe the legacy path before relying on it. Alibaba Cloud international registration is email + mobile (any-phone); Chinese-mainland identity verification (passport/driver's licence) is only required for products deployed in mainland China.

evidence.proved: '百炼存储空间支持的最大文件数为10000个，总大小不超过100 GB，暂时没有有效期限制' (10,000 files, 100 GB, no expiry); '单个文件最大为 150 MB' for file-extract; batch 500 MB
